tours.name: Finance: Create Fixed Asset - Factory Equipment

name_i18n.en_US: Finance: Create Fixed Asset - Factory Equipment

tours.description: Creates a new Fixed Asset using the Factory Equipments asset model (acquisition cost 100,000, 72-month straight-line depreciation, Fixed Asset account 11010170, Depreciation account 11020170, Expense account 72090050), confirms it, then reviews the Trial Balance and General Ledger to see how the depreciation entries update the ledger balance over time.

steps.title: Check Trial Balance - Depreciation Provision
steps.trigger: tr.line_level_1:nth-of-type(1) > td.line_name.text > div.wrapper > div.content > div.o-dropdown.dropdown > button.dropdown-toggle.btn
steps.content: The Trial Balance (with draft entries included) shows the Depreciation account 72090050 and Provision for Depreciation account 11020170 with the scheduled depreciation amount. Note the Fixed Asset account 11010170 does NOT appear here - creating/confirming the asset alone does not journalize the acquisition cost, only a source transaction (vendor bill or manual entry) would debit that account.

steps.title: Check General Ledger - New Machine Depreciation Entry

title_i18n.en_US: Check General Ledger - New Machine Depreciation Entry
title_i18n.si_LK: Check General Ledger - New Machine Depreciation Entry

steps.content: The General Ledger for account 72090050 (Depreciation Expense) shows the draft journal item for 'Factory Equipment - New Machine: Depreciation', contributing to the account balance for Aug 2026. This is how the ledger balance updates over time: each period's depreciation entry posts (Dr Expense 72090050 / Cr Provision for Depreciation 11020170) once its scheduled date arrives or it is manually posted.
